_comment: Accepted axe-core violations per page under the WCAG 2.2 AA tag set (wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa, wcag22aa). An entry here is a real, unfixed failure against that tag set, not a statement that the page is accessible. Each entry must be explained by a dated one-line reason under accepted_notes (page, then rule: 'YYYY-MM-DD: reason'); the test suite rejects an entry without one. Regenerate with SMOKE_A11Y_UPDATE_BASELINE=1.
